_doc: Research groups of the kit evidence pass. unit_id is the roster id of history/units.json where the roster has the unit, else the kit record id. fields: field -> [status, what is there now, source keys]; status letters D documented as built (support never re-read), I inferred, P plausible-procedural, G registered open gap, E empty; * = on the unit's own record. kit_fields: the same letters for each kit field. Built by tools/bt/kit_evidence_plan.py; never edited by hand.

field_vocabulary.roster: the unit as the record names it: designation, kind, place in the organization, on the field or not
field_vocabulary.commander: who commanded during July 1 to 4, with rank, order of succession and what happened to each
field_vocabulary.officer: any other officer the record names with the unit (field, staff or company officer, lieutenant upwards)
field_vocabulary.strength: men present, as a range with the kind of figure and the return or report it comes from
field_vocabulary.casualties: killed, wounded, captured or missing, as ranges with the return or report they come from
field_vocabulary.arms: shoulder arms and side arms of an infantry or cavalry unit: model and calibre as the source states them
field_vocabulary.guns: pieces of a battery: type and count as the source states them
field_vocabulary.dress: distinctive dress or equipment the record states (one line per statement, tied to one kit field)
field_vocabulary.horses: horses of a cavalry unit or battery: number present, lost or unserviceable
field_vocabulary.detachment: companies or parties absent, detached or attached, and whether the strength figure includes them
